name: Bigprosolution PVT LTD
india_angle: Bigpro Solution is establishing India's first independent MIL-STD-883 qualified Testing & Failure Analysis laboratory in Hosur, Tamil Nadu.
summary: Bigpro Solution is an independent semiconductor testing laboratory in India, specializing in MIL-STD-883 qualified testing and failure analysis. They provide precision-driven engineering solutions for semiconductor reliability, targeting sectors such as defence, space, and automotive electronics.
